info.title: Customer API
info.description:
# Customer API

GraphQL + REST for the Tomago **website / storefront** (like Medusa **Store API**).

## Base URLs

| Environment | URL |
|-------------|-----|
| Staging | `https://tomago-staging-7125900076.europe-west3.run.app` |
| Production | `https://tomago-649000455905.europe-west3.run.app` |

## Auth

1. `POST /api/auth/login` → JWT + `authenticationUid`
2. `POST /api/auth/token` → Firebase `idToken`
3. GraphQL: `Authorization: Bearer <idToken>`

Requires `accountType: customer` for authenticated ops.

## Seed user

`ahmed.ali@tomoga.demo` / `TomogaDemo123!` (after seed with auth)

post.description:
Email/password login. Returns JWT + `authenticationUid`.

**Next:** Get Firebase Token, then GraphQL.
Mint Firebase ID token from `authenticationUid`. Required for GraphQL.
Multipart field `files` (max 30). Auth: Firebase ID token.
